readings.title: The Cleansing of the House of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Hezekiah commands the Levites to sanctify the temple, which had been defiled.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 29:3] In the first year of his reign, in the first new moon, he opened <dn>את</dn> the doors of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and repaired them, [4] and brought in the priests and the Lěvites, and gathered them in the open place to the east. [5] And he said to them, “Listen to me, O Lěvites! Now set yourselves apart, set apart <dn>את</dn> the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of your fathers, and remove <dn>את</dn> the uncleanness from the set-apart place. [6] “For our fathers have trespassed and have done evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>, and have forsaken <dn>Him</dn>, and have turned their faces away from the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and have given their backs. [7] “And they have shut the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and they have not burned incense or offered ascending offerings in the set-apart place to the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl. [8] “Therefore the wrath of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> fell upon Yehuḏah and Yerushalayim, and <dn>He</dn> has given them up for a trembling, for an astonishment, and for a hissing, as you see with your eyes. [9] “And see, because of this our fathers have fallen by the sword. And our sons, and our daughters, and our wives are in captivity for this. [10] “Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl, so that the heat of <dn>His</dn> wrath turns away from us. [11] “<dn>My</dn> sons, do not be slack, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has chosen you to stand before <dn>Him</dn>, to serve <dn>Him</dn>, and to be attendants for <dn>Him</dn> and burn incense.” [12] And the Lěvites rose up: Maḥath son of Amasai and Yo’ěl son of Azaryahu, of the sons of the Qehathites; and of the sons of Merari, Qish son of Aḇdi and Azaryahu son of Yehallel’ěl; and of the Gěreshonites, Yo’aḥ son of Zimmah and Ěḏen son of Yo’aḥ; [13] and of the sons of Elitsaphan, Shimri and Ye‛i’ěl; and of the sons of Asaph, Zeḵaryahu and Mattanyahu; [14] and of the sons of Hěman, Yeḥi’ěl and Shim‛i; and of the sons of Yeḏuthun, Shemayah and Uzzi’ěl. [15] And they gathered their brothers, and set themselves apart, and went according to the command of the sovereign, at the words of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to cleanse <dn>את</dn> the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [16] And the priests came into the inner part of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to cleanse it, and brought out <dn>את</dn> all the uncleanness they found in the Hěḵal of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to the courtyard of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. Then the Lěvites received it to take it outside to the wadi Qiḏron. [17] And they began to set apart on the first day of the first new moon, and on the eighth day of the new moon they came to the porch of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And they set apart the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first new moon they had finished.

readings.title: Worship is Re-established
readings.subtitle: Hezekiah and the assembly offer sacrifices and rejoice in the sudden restoration of the temple service.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 29:18] Then they came in to Sovereign Ḥizqiyahu and said, “We have cleansed <dn>את</dn> all the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of ascending offerings with all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the table of the showbread with all its utensils. [19] “And <dn>את</dn> all the utensils which Sovereign Aḥaz in his reign had pushed aside, when he trespassed, we have prepared and set apart. And see, they are before the slaughter-place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” [20] And Sovereign Ḥizqiyahu rose up early, and gathered the heads of the city, and went up to the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [21] And they brought seven bulls, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering for the reign, for the set-apart place, and for Yehuḏah. And he said to the priests, the sons of Aharon, to offer them on the slaughter-place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [22] So they slew the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the slaughter-place. And they slew the rams and sprinkled the blood on the slaughter-place. And they slew the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the slaughter-place. [23] And they brought out the male goats of the sin offering before the sovereign and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them, [24] and the priests slew them, and with their blood made a sin offering on the slaughter-place, to make an atonement for all Yisra’ěl, for the sovereign said that the ascending offering and the sin offering is for all Yisra’ěl. [25] And he appointed the Lěvites in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with cymbals, with harps, and with lyres, according to the command of Daviḏ, and of Gaḏ, seer of the sovereign, and of Nathan the prophet, for the command was by the hand of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, by the hand of <dn>His</dn> prophets. [26] And the Lěvites stood with the instruments of Daviḏ, and the priests with the trumpets. [27] And Ḥizqiyahu gave the order to offer <dn>את</dn> the ascending offering on the slaughter-place. And when the ascending offering began, the singing unto <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> began, with the trumpets and with the instruments of Daviḏ sovereign of Yisra’ěl. [28] And all the assembly were bowing, and the singers singing, and the trumpeters blowing – all this until the ascending offering was completed. [29] And at the completion of the offering, the sovereign and all who were present with him bowed and worshipped. [30] And Sovereign Ḥizqiyahu and the rulers ordered the Lěvites to sing praise to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with the words of Daviḏ and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped. [31] And Ḥizqiyahu responded and said, “Now that you have ordained yourselves to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, come near, and bring slaughterings and thank offerings into the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” And the assembly brought in slaughterings and thank offerings, and all those whose hearts were so moved brought ascending offerings. [32] And the number of the ascending offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, two hundred lambs – all these for an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [33] And the set-apart gifts were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep. [34] Only, the priests were too few, and were unable to skin all the ascending offerings, so their brothers the Lěvites helped them until the work was completed and until the other priests had set themselves apart, for the Lěvites were more upright of heart to set themselves apart, than the priests. [35] And there were also many ascending offerings, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every ascending offering. Thus the service of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was re-established. [36] And Ḥizqiyahu and all the people rejoiced that <dn>Elohim</dn> had prepared the people, because the matter came about so suddenly.

readings.title: A Call to All Israel
readings.subtitle: Hezekiah invites the remnant of the northern and southern kingdoms to observe the Passover in Jerusalem.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 30:1] And Ḥizqiyahu sent to all Yisra’ěl and Yehuḏah, and he also wrote letters to Ephrayim and Menashsheh, to come to the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at Yerushalayim, to perform <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl. [2] But the sovereign and his leaders and all the assembly in Yerushalayim had taken counsel to perform <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ in the second new moon. [3] For they were unable to perform <dn>את</dn> it at its time, because not enough priests had set themselves apart, and the people had not gathered at Yerushalayim. [4] And the matter was right in the eyes of the sovereign and in the eyes of all the assembly. [5] And they settled the matter, to send a call to all Yisra’ěl, from Be’ěrsheḇa to Dan, to come to perform <dn>את</dn> a Pěsaḥ to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl at Yerushalayim, since they had not done it for a long time, as it is written. [6] And the runners went to all Yisra’ěl and Yehuḏah with the letters from the sovereign and his leaders, and spoke according to the command of the sovereign, “Children of Yisra’ěl, turn back to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Aḇraham, Yitsḥaq, and Yisra’ěl, so that <dn>He</dn> returns to the remnant of you who have escaped from the hand of the sovereigns of Ashshur. [7] “And do not be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of their fathers, so that <dn>He</dn> gave them up to ruin, as you see. [8] “Now do not stiffen your neck, like your fathers, stretch forth the hand to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and come to <dn>His</dn> set-apart place, which <dn>He</dn> has set apart forever, and serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, so that <dn>His</dn> burning wrath turns away from you. [9] “For if you turn back to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, your brothers and your children shall be shown compassion by their captors, even to return to this land. For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> shows favour and compassion, and does not turn <dn>His</dn> face from you if you turn back to <dn>Him</dn>.”

readings.title: A Joyful Celebration
readings.subtitle: A great assembly gathers, and despite some impurities, they celebrate the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread with unprecedented joy.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 30:10] And the runners passed from city to city throughout the land of Ephrayim and Menashsheh, as far as Zeḇulun. But they were laughing at them and mocking them. [11] Some from Ashěr and Menashsheh and from Zeḇulun, however, humbled themselves and came to Yerushalayim. [12] Also the hand of <dn>Elohim</dn> was on Yehuḏah to give them one heart to do the command of the sovereign and the rulers, at the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [13] And many people, a very great assembly, gathered at Yerushalayim to perform the Festival of Matzot in the second new moon. [14] And they rose up and removed <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-places that were in Yerushalayim, and they removed <dn>את</dn> all the incense slaughter-places and threw them into the wadi Qiḏron. [15] Then they slew <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ on the fourteenth day of the second new moon. And the priests and the Lěvites were ashamed, and set themselves apart, and brought the ascending offerings to the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [16] And they stood in their place according to their right-ruling. According to the Torah of Mosheh, the man of <dn>Elohim</dn>, the priests sprinkled the blood from the hand of the Lěvites. [17] For many in the assembly had not set themselves apart. Therefore the Lěvites were over the slaughter of the Pěsaḥim for everyone who was not clean, to set them apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [18] For many of the people, many from Ephrayim and Menashsheh, Yissasḵar and Zeḇulun, had not been cleansed, yet they ate <dn>את</dn> the Pěsaḥ contrary to what was written. But Ḥizqiyahu prayed for them, saying, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who is good, provide atonement for everyone [19] who has prepared his heart to seek <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of his fathers, though he is not cleansed according to the cleansing of the set-apart place.” [20] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> listened to Ḥizqiyahu and healed the people. [21] And the children of Yisra’ěl who were in Yerushalayim performed <dn>את</dn> the Festival of Matzot seven days with great joy. And the Lěvites and the priests praised <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> day by day, with instruments of praise before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [22] And Ḥizqiyahu spoke to the heart of all the Lěvites, those having good understanding concerning <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. So they ate during the appointed time, seven days, slaughtering slaughterings of peace offerings and making confession to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of their fathers. [23] And all the assembly took counsel to perform another seven days, and they performed it another seven days with joy. [24] For Ḥizqiyahu sovereign of Yehuḏah presented to the assembly a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep, and the rulers presented to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep. And a great number of priests set themselves apart. [25] And all the assembly of Yehuḏah rejoiced, and the priests and Lěvites, and all the assembly who had come from Yisra’ěl, and the sojourners who came from the land of Yisra’ěl, and those who dwelt in Yehuḏah. [26] And there came to be great joy in Yerushalayim, for since the days of Shelomoh son of Daviḏ, the sovereign of Yisra’ěl, the like of this had not been in Yerushalayim. [27] And the priests, the Lěvites, rose and blessed the people, and their voice was heard. And their prayer came up to <dn>His</dn> set-apart dwelling place, to heaven.

readings.title: Idols Destroyed and Tithes Restored
readings.subtitle: The people purge the land of idolatry, and Hezekiah organizes the priests and Levites, ensuring their provision through tithes.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 31:1] And at the completion of all this, all Yisra’ěl who were present went out to the cities of Yehuḏah and broke down <dn>את</dn> the pillars, and cut down <dn>את</dn> the Ashěrim, and tore down <dn>את</dn> the high places and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-places, from all Yehuḏah, and Binyamin, and in Ephrayim and Menashsheh, even to completion. Then all the children of Yisra’ěl returned to their own cities, each to his possession. [2] And Ḥizqiyahu appointed <dn>את</dn> the divisions of the priests and of the Lěvites according to their divisions, each according to his service of the priests and Lěvites for ascending offerings and peace offerings, to serve and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the camp of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [3] And the sovereign portioned of his possessions for the ascending offerings, for the morning and evening ascending offerings, and the ascending offerings for the sabbaths and for the new moons and for the appointed times, as it is written in the Torah of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [4] And he said to the people, those who dwelt in Yerushalayim, to give <dn>את</dn> the portion for the priests and the Lěvites, so that they are strengthened in the Torah of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [5] And as the word spread, the children of Yisra’ěl brought <dn>את</dn> large quantities of the first-fruits of grain and wine, and oil and honey, and of all the increase of the field. And they brought in the tithe of all, a large amount. [6] And the children of Yisra’ěl and Yehuḏah, those who dwelt in the cities of Yehuḏah, brought <dn>את</dn> the tithe of cattle and sheep. Even <dn>את</dn> the tithe of set-apart gifts which were set apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn> were brought in, and they gave heaps, heaps. [7] In the third new moon they began to pile up the heaps, and they finished in the seventh new moon. [8] And Ḥizqiyahu and the leaders came and saw the heaps, and they blessed <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> people Yisra’ěl. [9] And Ḥizqiyahu asked <dn>את</dn> the priests and the Lěvites about the heaps. [10] And Azaryahu the chief priest, from the house of Tsaḏoq, answered him and said, “Since they began to bring <dn>את</dn> the offerings into the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, we have had enough to eat and have plenty left, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has blessed <dn>His</dn> people. And this great amount is left over.” [11] And Ḥizqiyahu ordered them to prepare <dn>את</dn> rooms in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and they prepared them. [12] Then they brought in <dn>את</dn> the contribution, and <dn>את</dn> the tithes, and <dn>את</dn> the set-apart gifts, trustworthily. And Konanyahu the Lěvite was leader over them, and Shim‛i his brother was the next. [13] And Yeḥi’ěl, and Azazyahu, and Naḥath, and Asah’ěl, and Yerimoth, and Yozaḇaḏ, and Eli’ěl, and Yismaḵyahu, and Maḥath, and Benayahu were overseers under the hand of Konanyahu and Shim‛i his brother, by order of Ḥizqiyahu the sovereign and Azaryahu the ruler of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>. [14] And Qorě son of Yimnah the Lěvite, the keeper of the East Gate, was over the voluntary offerings to <dn>Elohim</dn>, to distribute the offerings of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and the most set-apart gifts. [15] And under his hand were Ěḏen, and Minyamin, and Yěshua, and Shemayahu, Amaryahu, and Sheḵanyahu, in the cities of the priests, to distribute trustworthily to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as the small. [16] Besides those males from three years old and up who were written in the genealogy, they distributed to everyone who entered the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> his daily portion for the work of his service, by his division, [17] and to the priests who were written in the genealogy according to their father’s house, and to the Lěvites from twenty years old upward, by their duties in their divisions, [18] and to all listed in the genealogy, their little ones and their wives, their sons and daughters, all the company of them. For in their trustworthiness they set themselves apart in set-apartness. [19] And for the sons of Aharon the priests, who were in the fields of the open land of their cities, in each and every city, there were men who were called by name to distribute portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogies among the Lěvites. [20] And Ḥizqiyahu did this in all Yehuḏah, and he did what was good and what was right and what was true before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> his <dn>Elohim</dn>. [21] And in every work that he began in the service of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>, in the Torah and in the command, to seek <dn>את</dn> his <dn>Elohim</dn>, with all his heart, he did and prospered.
